tasks.label: Flutter: Watch Gen L10n
args: $watcher = New-Object System.IO.FileSystemWatcher; $watcher.Path = 'lib/l10n'; $watcher.Filter = '*.arb'; $watcher.IncludeSubdirectories = $false; Register-ObjectEvent -InputObject $watcher -EventName 'Changed' -Action { Write-Host 'ARB file changed, regenerating localization...'; flutter gen-l10n } | Out-Null; Write-Host 'Watching l10n folder for changes...'; while($true) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 }
